prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-bleed 16:9 cinematic painted environment for an Udyr-inspired League of Legends champion-draft broadcast. Deliver a complete new high-detail premium fantasy game environment, dramatic hand-painted 3D concept-art realism, extraordinary scale and tangible materials, not a screenshot, not a UI mockup. Render 1920x1080 landscape if possible. Composition is deliberately stage-like: symmetrical opposing monumental spirit guardians in the UPPER LEFT and UPPER RIGHT thirds, wide epic central vista. Foreground has TWO long low stone plinth terraces at left and right, extending across x=3%-37% and x=63%-97%, y=72%-88%; their surfaces must be broad, level and unobstructed, intended to support five virtual champion shrines added later in code. Keep mid-left and mid-right y=35%-72% relatively dark and spatially quiet so five vertical portraits per side will read. Keep center x=39%-61% calm and dark for an eventual timer and team comms tablet, with an open view behind it. Center top x=41%-59%,y=4%-34% will be a circular live camera aperture added by code: use subtle environmental texture there, no focal figure. Foreground bottom center has a visible ritual channel joining both terraces, and an elemental source basin at x=18%,y=87% with matching basin at x=82%,y=87%; these will motivate animated effects. Do not draw any portrait frames, character selection cards, UI windows, lettering, words, logos, watermarks or numbers. All UI will be built precisely in code. Rich composition at the top, lower corners and edges, crisp materials, bold atmospheric depth, asymmetric small natural details within broadly balanced staging.

Scene/backdrop: THUNDER BEAR: a colossal mountain storm temple, obsidian claw-cut stone, rain-polished slate, luminous cobalt runes, silver chains and shattered spires. Two enormous carved spectral bear guardians in the upper side thirds, their open clawed paws aimed at the plinth terraces below. Storm clouds, a few concentrated lightning forks lighting the sky, electric blue/cyan rim light, deep navy shadow. Each lower source basin is a claw-shaped thunder conductor holding a small brilliant electric core. The terrace joins are deeply carved claw grooves. Ferocious, mighty, windswept, alive with thunder.

Scene/backdrop: JADE TURTLE: a sacred water sanctuary in a vast luminous cavern with pools, elegant jade stone, pearlescent shell mosaics, turquoise springs and golden-green vegetation along the outer edges. Two enormous protective turtle spirit statues in upper side thirds, broad segmented shells lit by soft teal veins, peaceful but immensely powerful. The plinth terraces are dark polished jade with shell motifs and green-gold trim. Each lower source basin is a circular carved shell fountain emitting a jade light. Protective magic, healing, regeneration, gentle sheets of falling water at distant outer edges, a misty pool behind the central stage, verdant reflections, luminous pale turquoise and deep emerald, dignified and epic.

Scene/backdrop: GOLDEN RAM: a glorious sacred mountain forge above the clouds at golden dawn. Two enormous black basalt ram guardians in upper side thirds with monumental curled molten-gold horns, mountains rising like a divine crown, fiery seams, carved bronze and dark rock. Terraces are immense ancient forge altars with gilded knotwork and chiselled stone, broad quiet dark surfaces. Each lower source basin is a horn-shaped gold forge crucible with a glowing ember heart. A deep molten-gold ritual channel joins the terraces below. Embers, sunbeams in volcanic haze, mystical strength, regal fire, awe-inspiring mountains. Rich warm gold against charcoal, accents of white mountain light.

Scene/backdrop: ASHEN PHOENIX: a magnificent frozen volcanic summit under an ash-and-snow blizzard. Two enormous phoenix guardians in upper side thirds, one sculpted of glacial turquoise ice and the other radiant ember-red feathers, wings sweeping outward around the top corners, with crisp readable avian heads. Dark obsidian terraces capped in pale ice, silver filigree and ember veins. Each lower source basin is a broken feather-shaped brazier, blue cold fire at left, warm orange fire at right. Wide distant snowy peaks and a volcanic glow, drifting ash, dramatic fire-and-ice duality. The ritual channel joins the terraces in a thin band of icy light and embers. Epic rebirth, not grim horror.
